reviews.author: Shade
reviews.title: Best RO purifier I’ve used in 10+ years – zero maintenance headache!
reviews.body: Having used RO purifiers for over a decade, the Urban Company Native M2 Pro is easily the best upgrade I’ve made. Unlike traditional purifiers that require servicing every 3–6 months and often end up with leakage issues, this one comes with 2 years of zero servicing required and complete coverage. I’ve been using it for 6 months now with zero issues—no leaks, great water taste, and smooth touch controls. What stands out: Smart & Convenient Features: One-touch presets (like 500 ml and 750 ml) make filling bottles and cups effortless, and it even runs on battery backup so dispensing still works

reviews.title: Excellent Product & Outstanding After-Sales Service
reviews.body: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Excellent Product & Outstanding After-Sales Service! 👏 I purchased the Native M2 Pro water purifier in March.... Initially, there was a delay of one or two days because the service technician had multiple purifier installation and repair jobs. I understand that such minor delays can happen, so I don't consider it a major issue. and after 8 months of usage, I can confidently say that the purifier is working in very good condition.
